comparisons.peer_summary: The company's strategy focuses on technology leadership in semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, achieved through strategic acquisitions and internal R&D to maintain market leadership and drive diversified financial results.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom disclose a capital allocation and business strategy that explicitly includes strategic acquisitions to drive growth and maintain leadership. Intel states it seeks to 'engage in mergers and acquisitions' as part of its capital allocation strategy to build stakeholder value, while Broadcom describes its strategy as achieving technology leadership through 'strategic acquisitions of businesses and technologies' alongside internal R&D. While Intel frames M&A as part of a broader financial capital discipline, Broadcom positions it as a core driver of its business model and diversified financial results.

sentences.text: We take a disciplined approach to our financial capital allocation strategy, which continues to focus on building stakeholder value and is driven by our priority to invest in the business.
We also seek to optimize our portfolio, look for innovative ways to unlock value across our assets, and, from time-to-time, engage in mergers and acquisitions.

Our strategy is focused on technology leadership and category-leading semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions delivering a comprehensive suite of innovative infrastructure technology products to the world's leading business and government customers.

We seek to achieve this through strategic acquisitions of businesses and technologies, as well as extensive internal research and development, to ensure our products retain their technology market leadership.
